digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter architecture / jira_family shared layer
propositions: Extract Jira-family-general symbols from adapters/jira/ into a new adapters/jira_family/ package to eliminate unsanctioned cross-adapter imports and establish a proper sub-seam within the adapter layer.

Relocate pure, location-unbound modules (identity.py, probe's classifier) and split jira_fields.py by symbol—moving self-contained units outright and contract-parameterizing sanitizers that depend on pinned modules (adf, comment_limits).

Unify duplicated local-to-Jira status and priority map literals by establishing adapters/jira_family/ as the sole definition site, adopting the outbound_fields value for deleted (Done, not Deleted) and re-pointing all internal importers.

Preserve location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) at their by-path-loaded paths by sharing them via dependency inversion—pinned modules import jira_family contracts, never vice versa.
Ensure adapters/jira/acli*.py logic remains unchanged and testable as import-only diffs, using aliased imports so underscore names, __all__, and call sites remain byte-identical.

Use absolute imports (not relative) in all modules including those loaded via spec_from_file_location with synthetic names, and bind Cloud-specific configured values (RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES, codec, comment limits) as injected contract parameters rather than module-level constants in jira_family/.
